description: The firm's AML/CFT, data-protection and AI-governance obligations, each mapped to the instrument that creates it, the owner who answers for it, the controls that discharge it and the evidence that proves it. Step 3 of the GRC framework (obligation inventory) and the denominator of the compliance-completion metric. The human view is docs/governance/obligation-register.md.
review_cadence: Quarterly, on any change flagged by Regulatory Watch, and on any new instrument entering force.
citation_policy: Instrument-level citations only. Article-level mapping to Cabinet Resolution No. 134 of 2025 is counsel's worklist (open-actions register item 5); no article number is asserted here that has not been verified in-repo. The one exception is Article 25 of FDL 10/2025 (tipping-off), which is already cited operatively in code and pinned by test/advisor-assurance.test.js.

status_meanings.met: Control built AND operating AND evidenced — nothing outstanding.
status_meanings.partial: Control built and evidenced; a human act (a sitting, a filing, a delivery, a signature) is outstanding. Every partial row names the open-actions register item that closes it.
status_meanings.pending: Firm-side obligation the repository cannot discharge or evidence on its own.
status_meanings.monitored: Not currently applicable; watched so that applicability change is detected rather than assumed.

obligations.obligation: Identify and verify the customer, and identify the beneficial owner, before or when establishing the business relationship
obligations.instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 10 of 2025; Cabinet Resolution No. 134 of 2025
obligations.note: The 0-30 methodology scores identification, ownership and UBO factors; hard rules force PROHIBITED regardless of score.

obligations.obligation: Apply enhanced due diligence to high-risk customers, PEPs and high-risk jurisdictions
obligations.instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 10 of 2025; Cabinet Resolution No. 134 of 2025
obligations.note: EDD triggers are hard-coded escalations that override the numeric band; PEP/RCA/SOE detection runs in the daily screen.

obligations.obligation: Conduct ongoing monitoring of the business relationship and scrutinise transactions for consistency with the customer's profile
obligations.instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 10 of 2025; Cabinet Resolution No. 134 of 2025
obligations.note: The R.16 engine is built and inactive: no transaction feed is wired. The prepared manual compensating control is drafted and unsigned.

obligations.obligation: Screen customers and counterparties against UN and UAE local terrorist lists and freeze without delay on a confirmed match
obligations.note: Daily screen with CI-enforced accuracy floors; an empty core list reads DEGRADED and never a silent clear.

obligations.obligation: File partial-name (PNMR), confirmed-name (CNMR) and funds-freeze (FFR) reports to the competent authority via goAML on a list match
obligations.note: Procedure written with the TFS gate ahead of the STR question and a §4 event log. Filing is a human act; the role-based training that makes it reliable is outstanding.

obligations.obligation: Report suspicious transactions and activity to the FIU via goAML without delay
obligations.note: The dossier builder assembles the narrative and evidence pack; the filing decision and the goAML submission are the MLRO's, outside the repository.

obligations.obligation: Do not disclose to the customer or any third party that a report has been or will be made (tipping-off prohibition)
obligations.note: Charter prohibition plus an independent post-output guard: the Advisor withholds the answer rather than risk the disclosure. Red-team phrasings are pinned in CI.

obligations.obligation: Keep customer, transaction and screening records for the statutory retention period and produce them on request
obligations.note: Stores, retention windows, lineage and purge are documented and the purge path is tested.

obligations.obligation: Appoint an MLRO with the independence, authority and resources to discharge the role
obligations.instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 10 of 2025; Cabinet Resolution No. 134 of 2025
obligations.note: The delegation matrix and RACI are documented; the appointment record and the committee's adoption are board acts.

obligations.obligation: Maintain a documented business-wide (enterprise) AML/CFT risk assessment and keep it current
obligations.instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 10 of 2025; Cabinet Resolution No. 134 of 2025
obligations.note: The repository holds the AI-system risk register (R-01…R-20), not the firm's business-wide assessment. The EWRA covers customers, products, channels and geographies the repository has no sight of; it is firm-side work.

obligations.obligation: Provide AML/CFT and sanctions training appropriate to role, and keep training records
obligations.instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 10 of 2025; Cabinet Resolution No. 134 of 2025
obligations.note: Cadence is scheduled and the record table exists; delivery beyond Compliance and the named rows are outstanding.

obligations.obligation: Maintain an independent audit function to test the AML/CFT programme
obligations.instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 10 of 2025; Cabinet Resolution No. 134 of 2025
obligations.note: The programme, scope and CAPA route are documented; the first thematic review has not run.

obligations.obligation: Report qualifying cash and cash-equivalent dealings at or above the DPMS threshold (AED 55,000), single or linked
obligations.instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 10 of 2025; Cabinet Resolution No. 134 of 2025
obligations.note: The threshold and the linked-series rule are encoded in the methodology and the compensating control; automated detection needs the transaction feed decision.

obligations.obligation: Process personal data on a lawful basis, minimise it, and transfer it cross-border only on a permitted basis
obligations.note: DPIA and PDPL assessment are complete and data minimisation is enforced in code (name + one headline). The transfer basis and the DPO determination await counsel and the board; LLM egress stays gated OFF until then.

obligations.obligation: Keep designation lists current and detect list changes without relying on manual checking
obligations.note: Daily refresh with per-list movement reporting, a freshness watchdog, and the EOCN mirror cross-check that alarms without becoming the screening source.

obligations.obligation: Maintain current registration with the supervisor and the goAML platform, and keep filing credentials live
obligations.note: Registration and credential currency are firm-side facts the repository cannot observe. Add the renewal anniversary to the compliance calendar once the date is known.

obligations.obligation: Meet EU AI Act obligations for the applicable role and risk class
obligations.note: Assessed as outside territorial scope today (no EU establishment, no EU market offering); the design aligns voluntarily with the high-risk obligations should scope change. General applicability of the broader obligations falls on 2 August 2026 and the source is under Regulatory Watch, including the Digital Omnibus amendments.

obligations.obligation: Operate an AI management system to ISO/IEC 42001 and decide the certification path
obligations.note: Self-assessed as substantially implemented. Readiness assessment vs certification vs continued self-assessment is resolution R6 at the board sitting. No Regulatory Watch source applies: this is a voluntary standard published by a standards body, not a supervisor feed, so revisions are picked up at the annual governance-pack review rather than by the watcher.

obligations.obligation: Source precious metals responsibly and evidence chain of custody (LBMA Responsible Gold Guidance)
obligations.instrument: LBMA Responsible Gold Guidance; OECD Due Diligence Guidance
obligations.note: LBMA and OECD sources are watched so a change in guidance is detected. The firm's responsible-sourcing programme (KYS, refinery due diligence, Step 4 audit) is outside this repository's scope.

obligations.obligation: Assess and control proliferation financing as a standalone risk, and cover it in internal controls and training
obligations.instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 10 of 2025, Article 3(3); Cabinet Resolution No. 134 of 2025
obligations.note: PF became a standalone offence under FDL 10/2025 and can no longer be treated as a sub-case of sanctions screening. The CPF policy, the separate PF section in the risk-assessment method and the distinct PF training module are drafted; approval and the PF section of the business-wide assessment itself are outstanding.

obligations.obligation: Obtain, record and transmit full originator and beneficiary information for wire transfers at or above AED 3,500
obligations.note: The data requirement and the escalation rule for an incomplete incoming transfer are stated in policy; systematic enforcement depends on the same transaction-feed decision as OB-03 and OB-13.

coverage_note: Every obligation names the Regulatory Watch source that would tell us it changed, or states why none applies. test/obligations.test.mjs verifies that each watch_source exists in data/reg-sources.json, each calendar_duty exists in data/compliance-calendar.json, every control and evidence path exists on disk, every partial row names an open-actions register item, and that no obligation cites a repealed instrument (FDL 20/2018, Cabinet Decision 10/2019) as an operative basis.
